portInfo.description: Greater Victoria Harbour Authority operates the deep-water cruise terminal at Ogden Point under the Breakwater District brand. Terminal information lists Pier A (1,100 ft and 800 ft berths; 100,000 ft² warehouse) and Pier B berths extended to 1,040 ft. Passenger guidance highlights James Bay adjacency and walk/shuttle options into the Inner Harbour for the Royal BC Museum, Parliament Buildings and downtown. Many Alaska-season calls are evening arrivals — verify hours ashore before booking distant gardens.

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.

thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Evening Alaska-itinerary calls are common — do not book a 4-hour Butchart tour without checking actual shore hours against all-aboard.
